description: T-195: which vocal sound an acting beat gets. Keys are emotion names (content/emotions), looked up as the full name ('happy/laugh') first, then the base name ('happy'). An emotion action becomes a cue when its start lies in the scene's rendered range and its intensity is at least minIntensity. The sound starts `lead` x the emotion's onset after the action start (0 = with the action). Emotions not listed, or with cue null, are silent. Levels: gain_db = levelDb + lerp(quietDb, 0, (intensity - minIntensity) / (1 - minIntensity)).
